slides.texte_overlay:
How to get ahead of most men
your age
Wake up early on weekdays. An extra hour in the morning, five days a week, adds up to more than 250 hours a year.
Learn one valuable skill deeply. Writing, sales, design, a trade. Real expertise beats being average at many things.
Spend less than you earn, always. Even on a small salary. Money discipline gives you freedom while others stay stuck.
Take care of your body daily. Training, sleep, real food. Health is the advantage that makes every other goal easier.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Small daily learning puts you ahead without anyone noticing.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Small daily learning puts you ahead without anyone noticing.

slides.texte_overlay: Find people who are ahead of you. Ask questions, listen, learn. A good mentor can save you a decade of mistakes.
Be patient and consistent. Most men give up after a few months. Those who keep going are the ones who win. Stay in the game.
